The '''''End of Days''''' was a [[Keldabe-class cruiser|''Keldabe''-class cruiser]] of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jerid Sykes]]. The ''End of Days'' was staffed by some of the Consortium's best [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and crew, and was often used as [[Tyber Zann]]'s personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Admiral Sykes and the ''End of Days'' led a Consortium fleet in a [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|battle]] against the pirates of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].<ref name="MotPQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''End of Days'' was introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|''Edge of the Empire'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying-game's]] supplementary adventure guide titled ''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]'', published on [[November 19]], [[2015]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="MotPQ" />
